label: Indexed Minimum Wage

notes.note: overlay checked; four bars as drawn (catalogue says three), arrow curve from black sheet
Passed the independent review (creative director) on first reading

corrections.what: Drew the rising arrow as one smooth cubic curve ending in a symmetric open chevron (arms about 15.5 px, 31 deg either side of the curve's end direction)
corrections.why: DR-03. The cubic follows the black sheet's sampled centreline within 0.36 px. In a frame along the arrow's end direction the arm ends sit at v -7.85 and +8.35 about the axis, so they were mirrored.

corrections.what: Spaced the four bars evenly, 20.2 px apart, with one common foot at y 106.75
corrections.why: DR-03 equal repeats. Bar spacing measures 20.1, 20.3 and 20.2 px. Their rising heights (tops at y 98.13, 95.13, 88.5 and 77.75) are kept as drawn.

corrections.what: Drew the dollar sign's S as two equal elliptical bowls (7.25 x 6.78 px), point-symmetric about (37.55, 43.8), with bars on the same axis
corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry. The bowls measure within 0.1 px of each other.

corrections.what: Gave the ledger one corner radius, 3.5 px
corrections.why: DR-03. Diagonal profiles give 3.45 and 3.6 px.

corrections.what: Drew every stroke at the set weight W, 5.5 px
corrections.why: DR-03 one line weight. The ledger's left edge and the arrow measure 6.0 px; the rules 5.0 to 5.25 px.

source_notes: Kept: the ledger as an open contour (its bottom edge stops at x 50.13 and its right edge runs down to y 106.75 with a free end), the dollar sign at upper left, two short rules beside it and two lower-left rules of their own lengths, the arrow kept clear of the bars. Count: the sheet shows four ascending bars, not the three the catalogue names; the image controls, so four are drawn. Red is the whole arrow, curve and head. Sheet difference: the red sheet's curve sits about 0.5 to 0.8 px below and right of the black sheet's in its middle third; geometry follows the black sheet, which costs about 0.05 of red IoU.
